main_text.p: Prov.18.19. Constr. אָחֵי: Aff. אָחִי Frater meus, Gen.20.5. אָחִיו Fratrem ejus, Genes.4.2. לְאָחִיו Fratri suo, Num.6.7. Plur. אַחִים Fratres, Gen.13.8. & sic Hos.13.15. ubi tamen Aben Esra & R.Sal. Pratum, Ulvam, vel Carectum exponunt; pro אָחוּ, de quo mox. Constr. אֲחֵי 2.Reg.10.13. Aff. אֶחָיו Fratres ejus, Jer.49.v.10. לְאֶחָי Fratribus meis, Psal.22.23. אֲחֵיךָ Fratres tuos, Genes.48.22. אֲחֵינוּ Fratrum nostrorum, Genes.31.v.32. Chald: אֲחֵיךְ Fratribus tuis, Eltæ 7. v.18.

אָחוֹת f. Soror; Num.25.18. Constr. אֲחוֹת: Aff. וַאֲחוֹתִי Et soror mea, Job.17.14. Plur. אֲחָיוֹת, & Constr. אֲחִיּוֹת, unde cum Aff. אֲחִיּוֹתַי Sorores ejus, Job.42.11. Et contracte; וַאֲחוֹתֶיךָ Et sorores tuæ, Ezech.16.55.
אָחוּ m. Ulva; Carectum, vel simpliciter, Gramen, Job.8. v.11. בְּאָחוּ In ulva, vel; In gramine, Gen.4.12.

אחז Cepit; Prehendit, Apprehendit, Comprehendit, Tenuit, Possedit: Hæsit, Cohæsit, ut 1.Reg.6.6. Ezech.41.6. Herere fecit, adjecit, adjunxit, ut 1.Reg.6.10. Construitur cū Accus. & sæpe cum ב. Niph: נֶאֱחַז Captus, Detentus fuit, Possessor constitutus vel factus fuit. Præter. וְנֶאֱחֲזוּ Et possessores fiont; Num.32.30. cum א quiescente, ut in Futuro Kal: Part. נֶאֱחָז Detentus, Gen.22.13. Plural. שְׁנֶּאֱחָזִים Qui capiuntur, Eccl.9.12. Pih. Partic. מְאַחֵז Continet, Job.26.9. Hoph. Part. מְאֻחָזִים Comprehensi, Conjuncti; 2.Par.9.18.
אחזות Possessio: Construct. וַאֲחֻזַּת רָעִיר Et possessionem urbis, Ezech.45. v.6: Aff. וַאֲחֻזָּתְךָ Et possessionem tuam, Psal.2.v.8.
אחל אֲחָלִי Utinam, 2.Reg.5.3. Et in Pathach, אֲחָלִי, Psalm.119.5. Sunt qui a חָלָה deducant, quod in Pihel

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are transcribed as far as visible at this resolution; points marked [?] are uncertain. The Latin abbreviation "Eltæ 7. v.18." is copied as printed (probably Esth.7.v.18) and is uncertain. The entry "אֲחַוְיְרָא" and the lemma "רָעִיר" are uncertain. Large lemma letters (אחז, אחזות, אחל) are the printed headwords. Text is not split into lines; the last entry continues onto the printed right-aligned word "Pihel".
